Thank you To help strenghten Palestinian institutions and develop capacities to assume full responsibilities in the Gaza strip and parts of the Northern West Bank and to prepare for future statehood. Components and beneficiaries 1. Disengagement: (A) asset transfer, management and disposal (TMD): (i) PA entity charged with handling the settlement assets, (ii) inter-ministerial committee (supervisory board), (iii) other PA entities involved in implementation, (iv) affected municipalities; (B) borders and passages: Ministry of Finance, Ministry of National Economy, Palestinian Customs Authority, among others. 2. Institution development: (i) Ministries of Planning, Finance, Civil Affairs, National Economy, Labor and Social Affairs, among others, (ii) the offices of the President and Prime Minister, (iii) the PLC. 3. Capacity development: (i) local training institution; (ii) ministries and units implementing donor projects. Activities Provision of technical assistance (local and international consultants) for: o analytical activities, e.g., carrying out of TMD preparatory activities, feasibility studies (port, industrial estates, etc.), legislation for a business enabling environment, total management regime for border crossings o policy advice, e.g., on trade relations, customs arrangements, international gateways o institution development, e.g., organizational reviews of ministries, implementation of ministry reorganizations o training activities, e.g., training needs assessments and staffing and staff development plans for ministries, training in monitoring and evaluation, procurement and financial management Provision of office equipment Provision of targeted support to entities involved in implementing the project Implementation Ministry of Planning: overall coordination and institution development component Designated PA entity (Ministry of Civil Affairs until established): disengagement component Local training institution: capacity development component
